key.name: toggle-shortcut
key.description: Global keyboard shortcut that shows or hides the search window. An empty list disables it.

key.name: max-results
key.description: How many results the search window shows at most.

key.name: panel-width
key.description: Width of the search window in logical pixels. It is clamped to the monitor width.

key.name: top-offset
key.description: Distance between the top of the monitor and the search window, as a percentage of the monitor height.

key.name: clipboard-history
key.description: Keep a list of copied text, shown by searching “clip”. Copies that password managers mark as secret are skipped.

key.name: clipboard-persist
key.description: Save the clipboard history so it survives screen locks and logging out. When off, the history lives only in memory.

key.name: clipboard-size
key.description: How many copied items to remember.

key.name: web-search-engine
key.description: Search engine used by the web search row. “custom” uses web-search-url.

key.name: web-search-url
key.description: An http or https URL where %s is replaced by the query, used when web-search-engine is “custom”.

key.name: weather-city
key.description: City used when searching “weather” without a city. It is sent to Open-Meteo only when you search for weather.
